recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up work is needed unless a future work-group decision changes the operation invocation endpoint model or reintroduces operations on historical resource versions.
issue_request: FHIR-20202 reported that the operations execution page said operations could be invoked on four FHIR endpoint types while listing only three. The final resolution was to correct the count to "three" because calling operations on _history had been removed.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-20202-tagged source commit was found. Commit 142ad7624ca77d81a9463a6ddbd278f521a109da changed source/operations.html from "four types" to "three types" while preserving the three endpoint bullets; that commit was filed under FHIR-19523, FHIR-22702, and FHIR-23809, and FHIR-23809's Jira text included the same operations-page typo.
additional_context: source/operations.html is an active root narrative page linked from current FHIR documentation, REST API, exchange, and workflow pages. source/history.html records GF#17258 as removing support for operations on historical resources, confirming that the old _history endpoint should not be restored. Same-change-family issues FHIR-25261 and FHIR-33083 are already represented on the combined branch, and negative Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current build-scope source already implements the accepted correction.
